one_line: MIT, archived Apr 2025 (last push 28 Feb 2025, 75 stars): Python package plus committed mapping files under mappings/stocks/ (mappings.csv 443 KB, ticker_to_cik.json 214 KB, cik_to_tickers.json 200 KB, cik_to_company_name.json 306 KB, exchange maps) and a parallel mappings/mutual_funds/ tree; also served over jsDelivr; US SEC registrants, frozen at the archive date.
abnb_use: Gap 15 (SEC EDGAR tooling): a ready CIK/ticker/exchange crosswalk to join ABNB, BKNG, EXPE, MAR, HLT, VCSA, SOND and any peer against XBRL frames, EDGAR full-text search and the financial-statement datasets without hand-deriving CIKs; mutual-fund series/class maps also support 13F/holder work.
